policy: Ambiguity Quarantine (F002 task 04). Exactly seven Quarantined Ambiguity families QA1-QA7, the closed union `QuarantineFamilyId` of 003 §Section 2. Each family names the clause its ambiguity is written in and the ADR amendment that would lift it. Binding rules from 001 §5: (1) every family carries a Scenario Identifier at status `declared-untestable`, never `[E]` and never `[B]`; (2) no Traceability Link may exist for a quarantined Scenario — one is a Quarantine Violation and fails the build (task 08); (3) QA6 and QA7 admit measurement without assertion, so a Benchmark Ledger entry recording an observed cost or timing is evidence while a test asserting a bound or an expected outcome is a decision and is forbidden; (4) a family lifts only by a merged ADR amendment naming it, after which its members re-enter the Scenario Register as `proposed`. This file is edited only alongside such an amendment. Membership: none of the 71 registered `004` §1-§3 scenarios falls inside a family — that document states at line 12 that no scenario below silently resolves these questions, and the two near misses (EAP-ERRP-003, EAP-SEC-005) assert normatively decided behaviour rather than an open one — so each family carries one minted EAP-QUAR-NNN member naming the undecided question itself, in the area 003 §Section 2 reserves for exactly that.

measurement.note: Measurement without assertion (001 §5 rule 3). A probe may build the volume fixture, observe row count, wall time, peak heap, fixture-build time and closure re-derivation time, and append the observation to the Benchmark Ledger with its runner fingerprint — that entry is evidence. A test asserting a maximum batch size, page size or completion bound is a decision and is forbidden; no observed value may be promoted into an expected one.

measurement.note: Measurement without assertion. A timing-differential probe may measure and record an observation — refusal code, response timing, closure count, with its runner fingerprint — into the Benchmark Ledger, and that record is evidence. It may never assert an expected outcome: no expected timing, no bound on the differential, no assertion that the code or count does or does not leak. Asserting any of those silently decides the open architectural question.
